This marks the third consecutive retrieval error where unrelated content (arXiv, Blockchain Wikipedia, and now Patent Wikipedia) is being returned instead of the actual Amazon product data. No pricing information, seller details, or inventory status could be extracted from this result. The next step should be to attempt using a different data scraping approach or tool to obtain the correct Amazon product information.

The system cleanup command was executed successfully, confirming the deletion of the event associated with the Sony WH-1000XM5 inventory stream from the ThingScale system. The response indicates that the threshold breach notification has ceased and the cleanup action was completed via the MQTT protocol. Since the previous scraping attempts failed to retrieve the correct Amazon pricing data, the next step should be to retry the data retrieval using a different method or corrected parameters to obtain the market pricing and inventory status.
